# Sports assignment template. Copy this file, name it after the slug, and fill in the [brackets].
# Load in Apature: Caption › Load assignment (or File › Load Assignment…).
#
# The slug is the editor's: MMDDYY SEC topic. The six digits are the run date, SEC is the section code
# (SPO sports, LOC local, COM community) and Apature fills IPTC Category from it. It also goes in the
# headline, the title, the job ID (transmission reference) and the file names.
#
# {variables} work in every field and in the caption endings: {iptcdow} {iptcmonthnameap} {iptcday}
# {iptcyear4} (the photo's own date), {year4}, {credit}, {headline}. Names Apature does not know stay as typed.
date: YYYY-MM-DD
slug: MMDDYY SPO SLUG Title
category: SPO
venue: [venue]
city: [city]
state: Pa.
country: USA
event: a football game
keywords: football; high school football; [school]; [opponent]
team: [Team]'s
photographer: [Photographer Name]/Example Press
credit: [Photographer Name]/Example Press
source: Example Press
copyright: © {year4} [Photographer Name]
caption_writer: [Photographer Name]
code: tail =  in a football game {iptcdow}, {iptcmonthnameap} {iptcday}, {iptcyear4}, at [venue]. {credit}
